name: DELTARUNE Fight [UPDATE]
desc:
A DELTARUNE fight sim fan game!

MOBILE and CONSOLES supported!

CONTROLS:
    Z: Confirm
    X: Go Back
    C: Depends, check in game 😭

Credits:
WolfyTheReject: Playable Berdly battle icons
TheJGuy07: Lots of custom playable character sprites
SumTheMun: WEIRD Route Knight song and idea

Credits for the original game all go to Toby Fox and the DELTARUNE team!
